# Association of Professional Builders Blog

> > Resources and insights for custom home builders focused on profitability, systems, and sustainable growth from APB coaches Russ Stephens and Will Blunt.

The Association of Professional Builders (APB) blog provides actionable advice for residential construction business owners through articles on financial management, marketing strategies, operational systems, and industry trends. Content features insights from the Builders Profit Accelerator program, APB Rewards Partners, and regular APB Digest updates.

## Key Topics

- Association of Professional Builders (APB)
- Russ Stephens
- Will Blunt
- Builders Profit Accelerator
- APB Rewards Program

- Custom home builders
- Cash flow management
- Builder marketing and lead generation

- AI for construction
- Construction industry trends
- APB Digest
- Business coaching for builders
- Builder success strategies

## Business Growth & Profitability

- [The 3 Fastest Ways To Grow A Building Company](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/the-3-fastest-ways-to-grow-a-building-company): Russ Stephens reveals 3 strategies for profitable building company growth
- [How to Boost Construction Profit Margins: Essential Tips for Custom Home Builders](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/construction-profit-margin): Will Blunt's strategies to boost profit margins for custom builders
- [How to Stop Working 60 Hours a Week and Build a Business That Runs Without You](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/buy-back-your-time): Russ Stephens on buying back time and building automated systems
- [How To Take Control Of Your Building Company](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/how-to-take-control-of-your-building-company): Russ Stephens on financial health and business control for builders

## Financial Management & Cash Flow

- [How To Get Paid In Advance](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/how-to-get-paid-in-advance): Russ Stephens on getting paid upfront instead of free quotes
- [The Truth Behind Failed Building Companies](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/truth-behind-failing-building-companies): Russ Stephens analyzes bad debt and receivership in building companies
- [8 New APB Rewards Partners Helping Builders Save Time, Improve Cash Flow & Protect Profit](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/new-apb-rewards-partners): APB Rewards Program adds 8 partners for cash flow and profit protection

## Marketing & Lead Generation

- [Why Most Builders Waste Marketing Spend With No Results](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/builders-waste-marketing-spend): Will Blunt explains why builder marketing fails and how to fix it

- [Why Good Builders Get Overlooked and How to Make Sure You're Not One of Them](https://blog.associationofprofessionalbuilders.com/why-good-builders-get-overlooked): Will Blunt on positioning to avoid being overlooked in tight markets
